notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves only DomainExpansionRateDataTable into DomainExpansionRateDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:256), and StartInitialLoading requests that asset by name (line 429).

No substantive C++ consumer of this row struct or any of its rate fields was found in Source/, Plugins/ or Config/. DomainExpansionDataTable has Id_DomainExpansionRate/_Ally/_Enemy references, but no source code resolves those IDs against this table, so their use is not proven here.

The GamePvESettings.cpp:250/253/254 matches for Damage_Rate, Down_Damage_Rate and GuardDurability_Damage_Rate are MissionCharacter row fields (GameMissionCharacter_CopyOverrideRates), not DomainExpansionRate fields; they are deliberately not cited.

All fields are therefore marked observed: their names, types, defaults and exported value ranges are known, but runtime application is unverified. Three exported rows (CP_140 and ally/enemy variants) share the schema; no localization variants were identified.
Partial Content means Blueprint/uncooked consumers cannot be excluded.
